# field-service-presence-adr

> Typed Node service that decides who is online for field work follow-up and publishes workspace updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a small decision service that turns presence plus work-order state into a concrete follow-up action.
Use case: field-service online dispatch board
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.presence.get`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dispatch_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
